Proximity

Eighteen questions about how you do closeness. Four minutes. Then I’ll tell you exactly what he is, and what the two of you are in for.

the first thing

How much of your attention goes on whether you’re about to be left.

the second thing

How much of yourself you keep back, just in case.

That’s the whole model. Everything else about how a person loves tends to follow from those two.

Answer fast and answer honestly. Not how you’d like to be, not how it sounds best — how you actually are. The clever-sounding answer is the one that ruins your own result, and you’re the only person who loses.

Your answers stay on your phone. All eighteen questions run right here — nothing saved, nothing sent, gone when you close the tab. The one exception: if you type something in the optional "your own words" box, that text gets sent once, at the end, to Claude, to write you a short reflection on it — then it's discarded. Skip that box and nothing ever leaves your phone at all.
